description: Implement Token Compression system (TokenJuice), Health Monitor with Heartbeat, and Connectivity Monitor. These are foundational infrastructure modules that other features depend on. Adapted from OpenHuman's tokenjuice, health, and connectivity modules.
steps: 1. Create src/core/token-compression.ts implementing a TokenJuice-inspired compression engine:
- Define CompressedResult interface: { text: string, stats: { rawChars: number, reducedChars: number, ratio: number } }
- compressForLLM(text: string, options?: CompressOptions): CompressedResult - main entry point
- stripAnsiCodes(text: string): string
- collapseWhitespace(text: string): string - collapse multiple newlines/spaces
- deduplicateLines(lines: string[]): string[] - remove adjacent duplicate lines
- headTail(text: string, headLines: number, tailLines: number): string - keep first N and last N lines with '[...N lines omitted...]'
- compressJSON(text: string): string - pretty-print then clamp to budget
- compressHTMLtoMarkdown(html: string): string - strip tags, keep text structure (simple regex-based, no external dependency)
- shortenURLs(text: string): string - replace full URLs with domain+path truncation
- CompressOptions: { maxChars?: number (default 1500), headLines?: number (default 8), tailLines?: number (default 8), strategy?: 'auto'|'head-tail'|'middle-out' }
- Export the module from src/core/index.ts
2. Create src/core/health-monitor.ts implementing a component health registry (adapted from OpenHuman's health/core.rs):
- Define ComponentHealth interface: { status: 'ok'|'error'|'starting'|'degraded', updatedAt: number, lastOk?: number, lastError?: string, restartCount: number }
- Define HealthSnapshot interface: { pid: number, uptimeMs: number, updatedAt: number, components: Record<string, ComponentHealth> }
- class HealthMonitor with:
- private components: Map<string, ComponentHealth>
- private startedAt: number
- markOk(component: string): void
- markError(component: string, error: string): void
- markDegraded(component: string, reason: string): void
- bumpRestart(component: string): void
- getSnapshot(): HealthSnapshot
- getStatus(component: string): ComponentHealth | undefined
- isHealthy(): boolean - true if all components are 'ok' or 'starting'
- getUnhealthyComponents(): string[] - list of components in error/degraded state
- Export from src/core/index.ts
3. Create src/core/connectivity.ts implementing network connectivity monitoring:
- class ConnectivityMonitor with constructor(config: { endpoints: ConnectivityEndpoint[], checkIntervalMs?: number, timeoutMs?: number })
- Define ConnectivityEndpoint: { name: string, url: string, method?: string, critical?: boolean }
- Define ConnectivityStatus: { endpoint: string, reachable: boolean, latencyMs: number, lastChecked: number, consecutiveFailures: number }
- checkEndpoint(endpoint: ConnectivityEndpoint): Promise<ConnectivityStatus>
- checkAll(): Promise<ConnectivityStatus[]>
- isOnline(): boolean - true if at least one critical endpoint is reachable
- getStatus(): Map<string, ConnectivityStatus>
- onStatusChange(callback: (endpoint: string, reachable: boolean) => void): void
- Default endpoints: Solana RPC (critical), OpenRouter API (critical)
- Export from src/core/index.ts
4. Update src/types/index.ts with new types:
- CompressOptions, CompressedResult
- ComponentHealth, HealthSnapshot
- ConnectivityEndpoint, ConnectivityStatus
5. Create tests/core/token-compression.test.ts:
- Test compressForLLM with text exceeding maxChars produces ratio < 1.0
- Test stripAnsiCodes removes ANSI escape sequences
- Test collapseWhitespace reduces multiple newlines
- Test deduplicateLines removes adjacent duplicates
- Test headTail preserves first/last N lines with omission marker
- Test compressHTMLtoMarkdown strips basic HTML tags
- Test shortenURLs truncates long URLs
- Test short text passes through unchanged (ratio = 1.0)
6. Create tests/core/health-monitor.test.ts:
- Test markOk sets component to ok status
- Test markError records error string and sets status to error
- Test markOk after error clears lastError
- Test bumpRestart increments counter
- Test isHealthy returns false when any component is in error
- Test getSnapshot includes all registered components
7. Create tests/core/connectivity.test.ts:
- Mock fetch to test checkEndpoint with successful response
- Mock fetch to test checkEndpoint with timeout/failure
- Test isOnline returns false when all critical endpoints fail
- Test consecutiveFailures increments on repeated failures
- Test onStatusChange callback fires when status changes
acceptance_criteria: src/core/token-compression.ts exists and exports compressForLLM function
src/core/health-monitor.ts exists and exports HealthMonitor class
src/core/connectivity.ts exists and exports ConnectivityMonitor class
All three modules are exported from src/core/index.ts
